caption_L1: Here a line chart is labeled Life expectancy (from birth) in Russia , from 1845 to 2020. The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis measures Life expectancy in years.
caption_L2L3: Life expectancy from 1850 to 1950 in Russia did not change very much. From 1850 to 1900 is was around 30 years, then from 1900 to 1950 it fluctuated more from the early 20's to just over 40. In 1948/9 it hit a low of about 20 years and then the life expectancy started to rise rapidly to around 70 years in the early 1950's. This figure decline to an average life expectancy of 65 in the early 2000's, rising again to 70, after that.
